scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @vet/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @vet/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vet/shared && npm run build --workspace @vet/backend && npm run build --workspace @vet/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @vet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @vet/backend
